references.text: The same five men who were sent to spy out the land, as mentioned earlier in the chapter
Describes the ephod and the teraphim that Micah made in his house
Refers to the carved image and the cast image that Micah made
Moses sent spies to explore the land of Canaan, a similar mission to the spies in Judges
Joshua sent two spies to scout out the land, especially Jericho
Rachel stole her father's teraphim (household gods), showing the use of teraphim in Israel's history
Description of the ephod that the priests wore, highlighting its religious significance
The prophecy that Israel will be without an ephod and teraphim for many days
